name: Bait and switch: the decoy
engine: Do not pass to Oyarzabal: a defender follows him, and the pass meant for him goes to Fabián.
about: The value is in NOT giving Oyarzabal the ball. Every attack a centre-back of theirs goes wherever he goes, so until Oyarzabal touches the ball a pass to him or a move by him in their half is -2, and a move by anyone else against one of their defenders is +1. A pass that was meant for him (or for any man they are watching) goes to Fabián instead, arriving late, and the pass to him is +2. Their defence remembers the last kind of move each of your men tried, so the same kind again is +2 to them and any other kind is +2 to you. On their attack, Rodri can leave a runner free on purpose and step into the pass (+2 the first time, and 2 less each time it works).
